responsibility: This header defines the shared data model for GCC's common target hooks. It introduces the opt_levels enum and default_options table format used to describe optimization options enabled at particular optimization levels, and it expands common-target.def to declare the gcc_targetm_common structure type and the global targetm_common instance that front ends and common driver/configuration code use to query target-specific behavior that is not tied to a particular backend code-generation file.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the paired .def file, this header turns the common-target.def hook list into concrete C declarations: it defines the supporting opt_levels/default_options types, expands the DEFHOOK macros into the gcc_targetm_common struct layout, and declares the global targetm_common instance.
